name: Ryoshuu no Onna Hero ~Kaijin-tachi to no Yami no Kyouen~
original_name: 虜囚の女ヒーロー ～怪人たちとの闇の狂宴～
source:
Sakurakawa Momoka is captured by a secret evil organization called Portion. Her comrades have sustained injuries from the its modified humen and were also captured.

In order to find out about Momoka's organization and its power, a Portion's executive, Lady Violet, lined up monsters in front of the woman and said, "Fight with them. If you win, I shall release you together with your comrades. But if you lose..."

Against the wickedly smiling Violet, Momoka resolved herself not to lose, even if she had to fight alone. However, it is not a fight that has started, but a wild party of ecstasy. The monsters have various powers to inflict pleasure, and so her reason has begun to gradually melt.

[i]What kind of end is waiting for her?..[/i]

[Translated from the [url=https://binbin1919.com/SKDG/ryoshu/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation: 樱川桃香被一个名为Portion的秘密邪恶组织抓获。她的同伴遭到改造人袭击、受伤后也被俘。为了查明桃香所在组织及其力量，Portion干部薇奥莱特女士让怪物们在她面前排成一列，并说道：“和它们战斗。赢了，我就连同你的同伴一起放你走。要是输了……”面对面带邪笑的薇奥莱特，桃香下定决心，哪怕独自一人也绝不认输。然而，开始的并非战斗，而是一场狂乱的欢愉盛宴。那些怪物各有带来快感的本领，她的理智也渐渐融化。[i]等待她的将会是怎样的结局？[/i][译自[url=https://binbin1919.com/SKDG/ryoshu/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
